related_questions.question: Did the Johnson and Johnson vaccine have spike protein?

text_blocks.snippet: Yes, the Johnson & Johnson (Janssen) COVID-19 vaccine did contain the spike protein. It utilized a viral vector approach, specifically using a harmless adenovirus to deliver the genetic code for the spike protein to cells. This genetic code then instructs the cells to produce the spike protein, which trains the immune system to recognize and fight off the actual virus.
